title: Throttle chat streaming auto-scroll work
goal: Reduce unnecessary scroll positioning during streamed responses while keeping the latest assistant output in view.
context: The streaming response changes in batches. Calling ScrollViewReader.scrollTo for every batch can add avoidable scroll/layout work while SwiftUI is already rendering new text.
forbidden_changes: Do not change streaming generation, provider behavior, message persistence, or cancellation semantics.
Do not remove the initial scroll-to-latest behavior or history-count scrolling.
Do not add a new dependency or timer service.
Do not claim physical-device smoothness from CI alone.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming auto-scroll is rate-limited to at most one scrollTo call per 120 milliseconds.
The first streaming update remains eligible for auto-scroll.
History changes and initial presentation still scroll to the latest message.
Agent Task Contract, M3 / package tests, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
Streaming remains readable and responsive on a physical iPhone.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If auto-scroll becomes noticeably laggy or skips the final position, revert the throttle or adjust the interval without changing stream semantics.
